articles.title: 科洛姆赢得密西西比州参议员选举
articles.summary: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆在密西西比州参议员选举中击败共和党现任辛迪·海德-史密斯，成为该州140多年来首位黑人参议员。民主党在参议院握55席，阿拉斯加席位未定。
articles.new_facts: 科洛姆击败海德-史密斯；票数差距不到5000票；民主党在参议院握55席；科洛姆成为该州140多年来首位黑人参议员。
articles.limitations: 票数与参议院席位来自BBC单一报道，票数由BBC转述CBS数据；历史意义由BBC与CNA标题互证。

facts.text: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆赢得密西西比州联邦参议员选举，击败共和党现任参议员辛迪·海德-史密斯。

evidence.quote: Democrat Scott Colom has won the US Senate race in Mississippi, delivering a shock victory for the party in a deeply conservative state that has elected Republicans for decades.
Democrat Scott Colom unseats Cindy Hyde-Smith in stunning Mississippi Senate win
Democrat Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat, becomes state's first Black senator since 1874

facts.text: 据BBC报道，科洛姆获得49.2%的选票，海德-史密斯获得48.7%，独立候选人获得2.1%；近百万张选票中，两人差距不到5000票。

evidence.quote: Colom, 43, won with 49.2% of the vote, while Hyde-Smith received 48.7% and an independent candidate got 2.1%, according to figures from CBS.
Fewer than five thousand votes out of nearly a million counted separated him from his Republican opponent, the incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith.

facts.text: 这一结果使民主党在100席的参议院中掌握55席，阿拉斯加的一个席位仍未确定。

evidence.quote: The result means the Democrats will hold 55 seats in the 100-member Senate, with a knife-edge race in Alaska still to be called.

facts.text: BBC称，科洛姆成为该州140多年来首位黑人参议员；CNA称，他是自1874年以来该州首位黑人参议员。

evidence.quote: Colom's victory makes him the first black person from Mississippi to be elected to the US Senate in more than 140 years.
Democrat Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat, becomes state's first Black senator since 1874

sentences.en: According to BBC, Colom received 49.2% of the vote and Hyde-Smith 48.7%, while an independent candidate received 2.1%; with nearly one million votes cast, the gap between the two was less than 5,000 votes.

sentences.en: The result gives Democrats 55 seats in the 100-seat Senate, with one Alaska seat still undecided.
sentences.zh: 这一结果使民主党在100席的参议院中掌握55席，阿拉斯加的一个席位仍未确定。

articles.event_key: 俄罗斯与乌克兰|举行|阿布扎比会谈并同意最大规模换俘
articles.title: 俄乌美阿布扎比会谈结束，未宣布突破
articles.summary: 俄乌美阿布扎比三方会谈结束，未宣布突破；双方确认大规模换俘在筹备，美国特使将赴莫斯科和都柏林。领土问题仍是最难议题。
articles.new_facts: 阿布扎比三方会谈结束未突破；双方确认大规模换俘在筹备；美国特使将赴莫斯科会见普京，随后赴都柏林会见泽连斯基；领土问题仍最难。
articles.limitations: 换俘人数与时间未公布；会谈细节主要来自BBC报道。

facts.text: 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国在阿布扎比举行的三方会谈11日结束第二天议程，未宣布突破。美方称看到一些机会，乌克兰谈判代表阿拉哈米亚称这轮会谈是“最艰难的一次”之一。

evidence.quote: Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day. Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs
Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest."

facts.text: 双方确认，大规模战俘交换正在筹备，可能很快进行。美国特使维特科夫和库什纳将于周四前往莫斯科会见普京，随后到都柏林会见泽连斯基。

evidence.quote: both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon

on Thursday US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner - President Donald Trump's son-in-law - would travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, and then to Dublin to speak to Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky

facts.text: 领土问题仍是最难议题；欧洲官员参与阿布扎比磋商，但俄方称其代表团未与欧洲方面接触。《卫报》报道，泽连斯基称看到和平的“机会之窗”。

evidence.quote: Kushner acknowledged that the territorial question remained the hardest

Representatives of Britain, Nato and various EU countries were also in Abu Dhabi and met with US and Ukrainian negotiators, but the Kremlin - with whom the EU does not officially communicate - said its delegation had not had any contact with them.
Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy sees ‘window of opportunity’ for peace as US envoys to meet Putin

bilingual.title_en: Russia-Ukraine-U.S. talks in Abu Dhabi end without announced breakthrough

sentences.en: The three-way talks among Russia, Ukraine and the United States in Abu Dhabi ended their second day on the 11th without announcing a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国在阿布扎比举行的三方会谈11日结束第二天议程，未宣布突破。

sentences.en: The U.S. side said it saw some opportunities, and Ukrainian negotiator Davyd Arakhamia called this round of talks 'one of the most difficult'.
sentences.zh: 美方称看到一些机会，乌克兰谈判代表阿拉哈米亚称这轮会谈是“最艰难的一次”之一。

sentences.en: The two sides confirmed that a large-scale prisoner exchange is being prepared and may take place soon.
sentences.zh: 双方确认，大规模战俘交换正在筹备，可能很快进行。

sentences.en: U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will travel to Moscow on Thursday to meet Putin and then go to Dublin to meet Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 美国特使维特科夫和库什纳将于周四前往莫斯科会见普京，随后到都柏林会见泽连斯基。

sentences.en: The territorial issue remains the most difficult topic; European officials took part in the Abu Dhabi consultations, but the Russian side said its delegation had not been in contact with the European side.
sentences.zh: 领土问题仍是最难议题；欧洲官员参与阿布扎比磋商，但俄方称其代表团未与欧洲方面接触。

sentences.en: The Guardian reported that Zelensky said he saw a 'window of opportunity' for peace.
sentences.zh: 《卫报》报道，泽连斯基称看到和平的“机会之窗”。

articles.event_key: 也门胡塞武装|宣称袭击|沙特利雅得哈立德国王国际机场等目标
articles.title: 胡塞武装宣称袭击利雅得机场和延布石油泵站
articles.summary: 胡塞武装宣称用导弹和无人机袭击利雅得机场及延布石油泵站，沙特联军称拦截多枚导弹和无人机，沙特未证实泵站遭袭。
articles.new_facts: 胡塞武装称用3枚巡航导弹袭击利雅得哈立德国王国际机场，用无人机袭击延布11号石油泵站；沙特联军称拦截多枚导弹和无人机；沙特未证实泵站遭袭。
articles.limitations: 胡塞武装与沙特方面对袭击结果说法不一；沙特未证实石油泵站遭袭。
entities: 利雅得哈立德国王国际机场

facts.text: 也门胡塞武装军事发言人萨雷亚11日通过社交媒体宣布，该组织用3枚巡航导弹袭击了沙特首都利雅得的哈立德国王国际机场，并用无人机袭击了沙特西海岸延布地区的11号石油泵站。

evidence.quote: 萨雷亚称，该组织武装部队使用3枚巡航导弹袭击了哈立德国王国际机场，并使用无人机袭击了沙特西海岸延布地区的11号石油泵站。

facts.text: 沙特主导的多国联军发言人马利基同日称，胡塞武装向利雅得地区发射的3枚巡航导弹被摧毁，2架无人机在麦加地区和沙特南部被拦截并摧毁；晚些时候又拦截2枚弹道导弹。路透社称，沙特方面尚未证实石油泵站遭袭的说法。

evidence.quote: 沙特主导的多国联军发言人图尔基·马利基11日表示，胡塞武装向利雅得地区发射的3枚巡航导弹被摧毁，该组织发射的2架无人机在麦加地区和沙特南部地区被拦截并摧毁。
报道称，沙特方面尚未证实其石油泵站遭胡塞武装袭击的说法。

facts.text: 萨雷亚还称袭击了也门境内沙特军队集结地并造成沙特军人伤亡，同时否认沙特关于在麦加上空拦截胡塞无人机的说法，称行动针对石油设施和军事基地，而非伊斯兰教圣地。

evidence.quote: 萨雷亚11日还说，该组织对也门境内的沙特军队集结地等目标发动袭击，造成沙特军人伤亡。
萨雷亚当日否认沙特方面有关在麦加上空拦截胡塞武装无人机的说法。他表示，也门胡塞武装的军事行动针对的是沙特石油设施和军事基地，而非伊斯兰教圣地。

bilingual.title_en: Houthis Claim Attacks on Riyadh Airport and Yanbu Oil Pumping Station

sentences.en: Yemen's Houthi military spokesman Saree announced on social media on the 11th that the group had attacked King Khalid International Airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh with three cruise missiles and attacked oil pumping station No. 11 in the Yanbu area on Saudi Arabia's west coast with drones.
sentences.zh: 也门胡塞武装军事发言人萨雷亚11日通过社交媒体宣布，该组织用3枚巡航导弹袭击了沙特首都利雅得的哈立德国王国际机场，并用无人机袭击了沙特西海岸延布地区的11号石油泵站。

sentences.en: Saudi-led multinational coalition spokesman Maliki said the same day that the three cruise missiles the Houthis fired toward the Riyadh region were destroyed, that two drones were intercepted and destroyed over the Mecca region and southern Saudi Arabia, and that two ballistic missiles were also intercepted later.
sentences.zh: 沙特主导的多国联军发言人马利基同日称，胡塞武装向利雅得地区发射的3枚巡航导弹被摧毁，2架无人机在麦加地区和沙特南部被拦截并摧毁；晚些时候又拦截2枚弹道导弹。

sentences.en: Reuters said Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed the claim that the oil pumping station was attacked.
sentences.zh: 路透社称，沙特方面尚未证实石油泵站遭袭的说法。

sentences.en: Saree also said that attacks had been carried out on Saudi troop assembly points inside Yemen and caused casualties among Saudi soldiers, while denying Saudi statements that Houthi drones were intercepted over Mecca, saying the operations targeted oil facilities and military bases, not Islamic holy sites.
sentences.zh: 萨雷亚还称袭击了也门境内沙特军队集结地并造成沙特军人伤亡，同时否认沙特关于在麦加上空拦截胡塞无人机的说法，称行动针对石油设施和军事基地，而非伊斯兰教圣地。
